fusions.name: Swinging Link
fusions.desc: Flicks a link at the first enemy it meets, dealing 4 damage, then swings to 1 more enemy within 3 tiles for 60% of that.

fusions.name: Pocket Knots
fusions.desc: Ties up every enemy within 3 tiles, dealing 12 damage and stunning each for 1 second.

fusions.name: Slip the Knot
fusions.desc: Removes every condition from you. Your movement speed rises by 25% for 4 seconds after you use it.

fusions.name: Light Fingers
fusions.desc: When you inflict a condition on an enemy, you regain 3 stamina. Once every 4 seconds.
